voter_accessibility.notes: Opening section (Your Brain Runs on Autopilot) uses concrete, familiar examples — walking, climbing stairs, chewing food. Body text rises to researcher/developer register in middle sections (dependency clusters, crystallization pipeline), but lensFraming voter text compensates effectively as the entry point. Acceptable for multi-persona architecture.

analogical_transfer_risk.notes: Thoroughly flagged. The Honest Caveat section (lines 192-201) directly addresses substrate transfer risk. Epistemic flags section includes five specific flags. Individual principle mappings note transfer risk inline. No unhedged transfer claims found.

citations_accuracy.notes: All 22 citations verified against known literature. One minor note: Guilford (1967) cited for mutual inhibition (Principle 4) connects through divergent/convergent thinking rather than neural mutual inhibition per se. The Nijstad et al. (2010) co-citation strengthens the claim. Not incorrect — the generate/evaluate alternation framing makes the connection clear — but readers expecting a direct mutual inhibition citation from Guilford may need a moment to trace the reasoning.

e_prime_compliance.notes: Zero E-Prime violations confirmed via automated scan. All be-verb forms absent from body text. Definitions use dash constructions rather than copular forms. Clean.

educator_pedagogical_pathway.notes: Clear progression: familiar biology → systematic inventory → theoretical framework → pipeline → dependencies → forgetting → design rule → safety implications → caveats. Follows familiar-to-unfamiliar trajectory. Meta-pedagogical layer (analogical reasoning as both method and epistemic risk) provides additional teaching value. The lensFraming educator text accurately maps this pathway.

additional_observations: Partial implementations (Principle 8+) use paragraph format rather than table format used for working/gap principles. Intentional stylistic choice (differentiating categories) but reduces scannability for the developer persona.
The Laozi Dao De Jing Chapter 76 reference (line 133) adds cultural breadth to the epistemic frame — appropriate given the WEIRD limitation flag in the epistemic section.
